# Vincent Azé

> Executive coach and Kuma Partners founding partner in Lisbon. Helping founders and leadership teams resolve friction, lead through change and navigate the human side of AI.

Canonical site: https://vincentaze.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/vincentaze/

## Entity summary

Vincent Azé: Executive Coach and Strategic Advisor, Founding Partner of Kuma Partners. Based in Lisbon, working internationally in English and French. Early career in international financial technology and commercial leadership; around ten years of executive coaching and advisory.

## Ecosystem routing

- Kuma Partners (the firm, 14-Day Leadership Friction Scan): https://www.kuma.partners/
- Leadership team offsites: https://www.kuma.partners/offsite
- The Round (peer advisory for founders and CEOs): https://theround.kuma.partners
- Dr. Sven Mulfinger (partner at Kuma Partners, one-to-one executive advisory): https://mulfinger.com

## Disambiguation

Vincent Azé is a person. Kuma Partners is the leadership advisory firm he co-founded. This site is his personal site. Whole-team work such as diagnostics and offsites is delivered through Kuma Partners.
